page.title: Sequences
page.description: Cadences of e-mails, calls and tasks that follow each contact until they reply.
page.emptyDescription: Create a sequence with automatic e-mails, tasks and business-day waits and enroll contacts in it.
page.noResultsDescription: Adjust the search or the filter.
page.noAccessDescription: Ask an administrator for the permission to view sequences.

stepHints.auto_email: Sent from the mailbox of whoever enrolled the contact, inside the sending window. Later e-mails reply in the same conversation.
stepHints.manual_email: Creates an e-mail task for whoever enrolled the contact, with the draft ready to review and send.
stepHints.call: Creates a call task for whoever enrolled the contact.
stepHints.linkedin: Creates a task to reach the contact on LinkedIn.
stepHints.task: Creates a generic task for whoever enrolled the contact.
stepHints.wait: Waits the given business days, in the organization timezone, before the next step.

editor.noAccessDescription: Only people who manage sequences can create or edit them.
editor.name: Name
editor.activeHint: Deactivating holds every enrollment until it is active again.
editor.dailyLimit: Maximum e-mails per mailbox per day
editor.windowHint: Automatic e-mails go out only on business days, inside the window and in the organization timezone. A contact never gets two sequence e-mails on the same day; when a limit is reached, the e-mail moves to the next valid time.
editor.stepsHint: Steps run in order. Use waits to space the touches.
editor.noSteps: The sequence has no steps yet.
editor.title: Task title
editor.templateHint: Subject and body filled below take precedence over the template.
editor.subject: Subject
editor.subjectHint: Accepts variables such as {{example}}. In later e-mails, empty replies with the conversation subject.

validation.window: The window must end after it starts.
validation.bodyRequired: Write the body or choose a template.
validation.subjectRequired: Enter the subject or choose a template.

detail.windowSummary: E-mails on business days from {{start}} to {{end}}, up to {{limit}} per mailbox per day.

metrics.title: Metrics per step
metrics.description: Sent counts e-mails sent and tasks created; opens depend on e-mail tracking; exits are enrollments that left the sequence right after the step.

enrollments.title: Enrollments
enrollments.description: Contacts enrolled in this sequence, newest first.
enrollments.emptyDescription: Enroll contacts from the Sequences tab of the contact, the bulk action of the list or an automation.

confirmExit.title: Remove {{name}} from the sequence?
confirmExit.description: No further step will run. To start again, enroll the contact once more.

record.emptyDescription: Enroll the contact in a sequence to follow up with automatic e-mails and tasks.
record.dialogDescription: The contact leaves the sequence automatically after replying, booking a meeting, having a deal won or lost, a bounced e-mail or an objection.
record.noMailbox: Sequences with automatic e-mails need a connected mailbox.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.description: The enrollments and step history of the sequence will be removed. E-mails and tasks already created stay.

errors.sequence_key_taken: There is already a sequence with this name.
errors.sequence_empty: The sequence has no steps to run.
errors.sequence_already_enrolled: The contact is already in this sequence.
errors.sequence_contact_objected: The contact objected to e-mail tracking.
errors.sequence_enrollment_finished: The enrollment already finished or changed status.
errors.no_mailbox_available: Connect a mailbox before enrolling contacts.
errors.mailbox_not_found: The chosen mailbox no longer exists.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed the sequence. Reload the page and apply the change again.

placeholders.name: E.g.: Welcome
placeholders.description: Describe the goal of this sequence
placeholders.subject: E.g.: Hi, how are you?
